pages.text: When she's full of water there's no saving her: she goes down. Don't despair, sailor: a $(l)new ship$() of the same kind will be waiting for her crew nearby, and you'll respawn aboard her.$(br2)A ship whose whole crew has left her sinks on her own after a while.
Whatever was in her barrels, chests and casks floats up in $(item)shipwreck barrels$(). Anyone can open one, or catch it with a harpoon. They sink for good after a while.
